detailed_description: Go Formatter is an online tool that formats your Go code following the official gofmt conventions used by the Go community. It ensures your code adheres to Go's strict formatting standards, making it easier to read and maintain. The tool handles indentation, alignment, spacing, and import organization automatically. Whether you're working on a small script or a large Go project, this formatter helps maintain consistent code style across your codebase. Simply paste your Go code and get perfectly formatted output in seconds.
